notes: «عن العمرى، وسنتها»: the subject of the report (the umra gift and its sunna), not a transmitter; left out. The source RWY reads it as a narrator (see fixes).
«عن حديث أبي سلمة بن عبد الرحمن» : Abu Salama is the link from Ibn Shihab; Jabir is the Companion who told him.

fixes.reason: The text names «العمرى وسنتها» as the subject of the report, not a transmitter; RWY stores it as a narrator between Ibn Shihab and Abu Salama.

evidence.quote: عن العمرى، وسنتها، عن حديث أبي سلمة بن عبد الرحمن
